what: Amon, the demon of wrath, a Marquis of Hell from the old grimoires: a towering, hunched, enormously broad demon with a jagged black iron coronet of five tall spikes on his head, standing upright on two legs, with the head of a great wolf: a long snarling muzzle, bared white fangs, ears laid flat and small furious yellow eyes. His whole body is coal-black like a log burnt through in a forge: his wolf head, chest, belly, arms, hands and legs alike are covered in short coarse charcoal-black fur, split by a web of deep cracks, and in every crack a dull ember-orange glow shows, as in a banked fire. His arms are longer and thicker than his legs and end in two enormous clenched fists. The fists are charcoal-black like the rest of him, real knuckled hands with four big dark knuckles and a dark thumb each, and each fist is on fire like the head of a burning torch: the cracks across every knuckle shine white-hot, and a close ring of pointed orange and yellow-white flames, each flame as long as one of his fingers, wraps round the fist and streams back along the wrist, joined to the hand. The dark knuckles show plainly in the middle of the flames. He has no wolf's tail: where the tail should be, one thick black scaly serpent grows from the base of his spine, curves up behind him and ends in a snake's head with open jaws. The serpent is the tail.
colours: coal-black fur and hide on every part of the body, the fists too, never brown, with dull ember-orange glowing cracks; a close ring of orange and yellow-white flames round each black fist, and white-hot cracks on the knuckles; yellow eyes, white fangs, a black scaly serpent tail with a snake's head, a black iron coronet, collar, shoulder plates and scale kilt.
wears: He wears a jagged black iron coronet of five short spikes between his ears, a broad black iron collar, two heavy black iron shoulder plates and a war-kilt of overlapping black iron scales down to his knees. His furred chest and arms are bare of armour.
holds: Both hands are empty clenched fists and hold nothing; each fist is a dark knuckled hand wrapped in a close ring of orange and yellow-white flames.
pose: He lunges to the left on two legs with one foot stamping forward, his body hunched and twisted, his white-hot right fist drawn back high above his shoulder to hammer down, his white-hot left fist thrust out low ahead of him, his wolf jaws wide open roaring, and behind him the black serpent that is his tail rising in an S as high as his shoulder at the right of the picture, its snake head hissing.
must_show: a huge hunched wolf-headed demon on two legs, charcoal-black all over with ember-glowing cracks
two enormous dark knuckled fists, each wreathed in a rim of white-hot fire, readable in the small sprite
the fists are hands on fire, never solid yellow shapes
a serpent for a tail
black iron coronet and scale kilt
empty fists, no weapon
a seal boss: the most imposing thing on its sheet
must_not_show: balls of fire held in the hands
furry wolf tail as well as the serpent

what: Buer, the demon of pestilence, exactly as the old engraving in the Dictionnaire Infernal shows him: one huge lion's head with a great mane and no body, and five goat's legs growing straight out from behind the mane all round it, so that the whole creature is a ring of legs round a face and rolls along on its hooves. The lion's head, seen from the front, is the centre of the picture: the gaunt, sick, ancient face of a lion with sunken cheeks, a wrinkled snarling muzzle, long yellowed fangs and two clouded milk-white eyes, wrapped in a huge ragged matted mane. The five legs are spaced evenly round the mane and point in five different directions: one sticks straight up above the top of the head, one sticks out to the left, one sticks out to the right, and two point down and outward. Each is the thin, bony, shaggy hind leg of a goat, bent at the hock, and each ends in one hard black cloven hoof: a split hoof in two halves, the foot of a goat.
colours: a pale sickly tan-yellow lion's face with grey mangy patches, a dirty straw-coloured mane matted with grey, milk-white eyes, yellowed fangs, a dark mouth, five thin goat legs of shaggy grey-brown hair, each ending in a black cloven hoof, one small puff of bile-yellow vapour at the mouth.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: It rolls to the left, the whole ring of legs tilted over to the left as it turns: the two lower legs stride on their hooves, the left and right legs stick out sideways, and the fifth leg kicks straight up above the mane with its black hoof highest of all. The lion's face is turned to the viewer with its jaws wide open, breathing out one small puff of bile-yellow vapour that is joined to its mouth and no bigger than its muzzle.
must_show: one maned lion's head, face-on, with no body
five thin goat legs radiating all round the head, one of them straight up, each ending in a black cloven hoof
sick jaundice-yellow and grey colouring, milk-white eyes
a seal boss: grim and painted, not a cartoon mascot
nothing under it
must_not_show: man's body with a lion head

what: Mammon, the demon of famine and of greed, a prince of Hell: an immensely tall, stooped, starved giant standing on two legs, as thin as a dead tree. His skin is dry ash-grey, shrunk tight on the bone on his face, neck and hands alike. He has a long narrow hairless head with hollow cheeks, two small pale gleaming eyes sunk deep under a bony brow, a long heavy lower jaw hanging open and full of long yellow teeth, and two long thin straight ash-grey horns sweeping back from his brow. His neck is thin and corded. His arms are enormously long and thin, and his bony hands, with fingers twice as long as a man's, would hang to his knees. He has a small head, narrow shoulders and very long limbs, about ten heads tall.
colours: dry ash-grey skin, pale eyes, yellow teeth, a long robe of old dark gold brocade, the brown-gold of tarnished brass, with a black embroidered border and dark brown moth-eaten edges, a tarnished gold coronet, three heavy bright gold neck chains and gold finger rings, a wide black belt, a dark brown wooden strongbox bound with black iron bands and a black iron padlock.
wears: He wears the rotted finery of a merchant prince, hanging loose and far too big on his starved frame: a long heavy moth-eaten robe of old dark gold brocade with a black embroidered border and wide sleeves, pulled in tight at his sunken waist by a wide black belt, three heavy gold chains lying on his chest, gold rings on his long fingers and a tall tarnished gold coronet set between his horns.
holds: Under his left arm he clutches exactly one strongbox tight against his ribs: a dark wooden chest as big as his own chest, bound with black iron bands, its lid shut and locked with one big black iron padlock. His right hand is empty: his right arm is stretched far out ahead of him with the long bony fingers spread wide to grasp.
pose: He lurches forward to the left on two long thin legs, stooped far over, his right arm reaching far out ahead with the long fingers spread to seize, the locked strongbox hugged under his left arm, his long jaw hanging open, the oversized gold robe trailing behind him.
must_show: a very tall starved stooped demon with ash-grey skin and a long hanging jaw
a rich robe of tarnished gold cloth, gold coronet and gold chains
one locked iron-bound strongbox clutched under the left arm
a very long thin right arm reaching out, long bony fingers spread, empty
a seal boss: gaunt, rich and imposing

what: Bael, the demon of war, first of the kings of Hell, as the old grimoires draw him: a three-headed giant king, one body with three heads. He is one massive, very broad, heavily armoured giant standing on two legs and facing the viewer. His three heads sit in one row across the top of his body, crowded together cheek to cheek so that they touch, all three the same size, their three chins level, all three faces turned to the viewer, like the three heads of Cerberus. The middle head is the head of a grim human king: a hard scarred face with a hooked nose, cold eyes and a thick black beard. Pressed against his cheek at the left of the picture is the head of a monstrous toad, exactly as big as the king's head: a real toad's head, hairless, wet and covered in big round warts, dark mud-grey all over, wider than it is tall, with no ears, no fur and no whiskers, a mouth that is one long grim down-turned slit running the whole width of the head, a pale grey throat pouch below it, and two big round bulging dull yellow eyes with black slot pupils set high on top of the head. Pressed against his other cheek at the right of the picture is the head of a great black cat, exactly as big as the king's head: lean and scarred, ears laid back, yellow slit eyes, jaws open snarling with long white fangs. Each of the three heads wears its own spiked black iron crown; the king's is the tallest. The three heads share the one body: all three necks run down into one wide dark iron collar that spans his chest, and the toad and the cat have no bodies, no backs and no legs of their own. Below the collar he is one armoured man with two arms and two legs.
colours: a king's full plate armour of blackened steel, dark gunmetal-grey and nearly black, with pale worn steel edges, a wide dark iron collar, a black beard and weather-beaten pale tan skin on the middle head, three black iron crowns, a dark mud-grey hairless warty toad head with dull yellow eyes, a black cat head with yellow eyes and white fangs, a dark red armoured skirt lining, a bright steel sword, a dark iron shield.
wears: He wears a king's full suit of heavy plate armour of blackened steel: one great wide iron collar under the three heads; below it one smooth, rounded, plain breastplate with a single raised ridge down its middle, covering his whole chest and belly as one unbroken curved sheet of dark steel with no body shapes on it; big layered round shoulder plates; arm plates, gauntlets and leg plates; and an armoured skirt of long narrow overlapping sword blades, points downward, with bright worn edges, over a dark red lining. No bare skin shows anywhere below the three heads. He has no cloak, no cape, no fur and no hood: there is nothing behind his heads but the plain backdrop. Each head wears a spiked black iron crown.
holds: He holds exactly one great broad straight war sword in his right hand, a long knightly greatsword with a bright steel blade as long as he is tall from heel to shoulder and a wide cross-guard, held low with the arm out to the side and the long blade slanting down and outward so that its point is level with his ankle, well below the heads. On his left arm he carries exactly one tall heavy shield of plain dark iron with a dented riveted rim, held low beside his hip so that it hides none of the three heads.
pose: He strides straight toward the viewer on two legs with one armoured foot forward, his chest and all three heads facing the viewer, the three crowned heads in one tight row, cheek to cheek, the toad at the left, the bearded king in the middle, the cat at the right; his right arm is out to the side with the war sword pointing down and outward, the iron shield low on his left arm, the bearded mouth open in a hoarse shout.
must_show: three crowned heads of equal size in one tight row, cheek to cheek, on one body: a toad's head, a bearded king's head, a black cat's head, readable in the small sprite
plainly one three-headed king, not a man with two animals behind him
one armoured body with two arms and two legs
dark iron plate with a skirt of blades
one great sword in the right hand, one tall iron shield on the left arm
a seal boss: grim, a king of war
must_not_show: man with a toad and a cat peeking over his shoulders
animal heads behind the man's shoulders
breastplate shaped like a bare chest

what: Beleth, the demon of the earthquake, a king of Hell who rides a pale horse, and the ground breaks where he passes: one horse and one rider, and both look as if they were hewn from cracked rock. The horse is a huge, heavy, gaunt war-horse, a real horse on four legs seen from the side, pale as ash: its ash-grey hide is split all over by long, dark, jagged cracks like dried and broken earth, on the neck, shoulder, flank and rump alike, and a dull blood-red glow shows deep in every crack. From the knee down each of its four legs is rough dark grey stone, ending in an enormous hoof that is a cracked block of dark stone with red light in its cracks. Its mane and tail are ragged and black, and its eyes burn dull red. The rider is a giant sitting upright on the horse's back, built like a tower and clad from neck to foot in armour of rock: rough-hewn blocks of dark grey stone fitted together like a castle wall, with jagged broken edges and wide black seams between the blocks, and in every seam a deep blood-red light, the colour of the moon in eclipse. His head is a closed helm that is one rough block of the same dark rock with one narrow glowing red eye-slit, and on the helm stands a tall crown of jagged black stone spikes. A long ragged cloak of coarse black sackcloth hangs from his shoulders over the horse's rump.
colours: a pale ash-grey horse with dark jagged cracks all over its hide, dull blood-red light in the cracks, dark grey stone lower legs and hooves, a ragged black mane and tail and dull red eyes; a rider in dark charcoal-grey rough stone-block armour with black seams and blood-red glowing fissures, a red eye-slit, a crown of black stone spikes, a ragged black sackcloth cloak, a maul with a dark iron-bound haft and a huge rough dark grey boulder for a head.
wears: The rider wears armour of rough dark stone blocks over his whole body, cracked, with red light in the seams, a closed rock helm, a tall crown of black stone spikes and a ragged black sackcloth cloak. The horse wears no saddle cloth and no bridle; it is bare cracked ash-grey hide and stone.
holds: The rider holds exactly one great war-maul in both hands, swung down in front of him to the left: a thick dark haft as long as his arm, and for its head one huge, rough, jagged dark grey boulder as big as the horse's head, cracked, with red light in its cracks. The boulder head of the maul is at the left of the picture, ahead of the horse's chest and level with the horse's shoulder, in the middle of its downward stroke. He holds nothing else.
pose: Seen in full profile from the side like a figure on a coin, facing left: the pale cracked horse tramps forward on four legs with its head lowered and its neck arched, its near front leg lifted high and bent with the great stone hoof about to stamp down, its other three stone hooves planted; the rider leans far forward over the horse's neck, both arms stretched down and forward in the middle of a great downward blow, the boulder-headed maul sweeping down ahead of the horse's chest, cloak streaming behind to the right.
must_show: one ash-pale horse on four legs, seen from the side, its hide cracked like broken earth with red light in the cracks
stone lower legs and huge cracked stone hooves, one front hoof raised to stamp
one giant rider armoured in rough dark stone blocks with blood-red glowing fissures, plainly rock and not steel
a crown of black stone spikes on a closed rock helm
one boulder-headed maul swinging down, readable in the small sprite
a seal boss that says earthquake: not a knight on a clean white horse
must_not_show: bronze helmet with a horsehair crest
horse rearing upright on two legs

what: Abyzou, the demon of silence, the sleepless demoness of the Testament of Solomon: a very tall, gaunt, terrible queen of the abyss who floats upright in the air. She wears a mask over her whole face: one smooth, blank mask of black iron, oval like an egg, the darkest thing in the picture, with no mouth, no nose and no lips shaped on it at all, only two big round eye-holes, each a third of the mask wide, and each eye-hole is filled to the brim with solid bright pale yellow light. The blank mouthless black iron mask is her face. Her hair is very long, straight and pure white, and every strand of it floats straight upward from the top of her head, as hair does on someone falling: it rises above the mask in one tall, narrow, tapering plume of loose white strands, three times the height of her head. Her hands are cold pale lavender-grey, long and thin, with long black nails. She has realistic adult proportions: a small head, a long neck, long thin arms, about nine heads tall.
colours: a smooth black iron mask with two big round eyes of solid bright pale yellow light, pure white hair, pale lavender-grey hands with black nails, a heavy deep midnight-violet gown with wide hanging sleeves lined in pale silver-grey, silver embroidery down the front and round the hem, a tall silver collar and a broad silver belt.
wears: She wears a heavy, rich, high-necked gown of deep midnight-violet with silver embroidery down the front and round the hem, a tall stiff silver collar round her throat, a broad silver belt, and enormous wide sleeves that hang from her wrists nearly to her knees, lined with pale silver-grey, tattered at their ends. The gown falls straight down past where her feet would be and ends in a long ragged trailing hem, so that she has no feet to be seen.
holds: Her hands are empty and she holds nothing. Her right hand is raised to the mask with one long forefinger held upright against it, touching the blank black iron where a mouth would be, the sign for silence; her left arm is stretched out ahead with the palm open and the long thin black-nailed fingers spread.
pose: She drifts to the left through the air, leaning forward, her right forefinger upright against the front of her blank black iron mask, her left arm stretched far out ahead so that its great wide sleeve hangs open below it, the heavy gown and its ragged hem trailing down and back to the right, the tall plume of white hair streaming straight up above her head, her yellow eyes staring at the viewer out of the mask. The tip of the hair and the hem of the gown are both well inside the picture.
must_show: a tall gaunt woman demon floating, fully clothed in a rich dark violet gown with enormous hanging sleeves
a blank smooth silver mask for a face: two round eye-holes, no mouth, no nose
white hair floating straight up in one tall plume above her head, readable in the small sprite
two wide staring pale yellow eyes in the mask
one finger raised against the mask where a mouth would be, the other hand reaching, both empty
a seal boss: still, cold and imposing
must_not_show: hair hanging down over the shoulders
cloud of mist around the body
hair reaching the top edge of the picture

what: a cobra: a real Egyptian cobra, an ordinary snake, an animal, of ordinary slender build. The rear half of its body lies in one loose flat loop, and the front third rises upright in a slim S-curve to a flat spread hood, a little wider than a hand, with a small blunt snake's head on top: round dark eyes, an open mouth with two short white fangs and a thin forked black tongue. Its scales are small, dull and dusty. The thin tip of its tail lies out behind the loop.
colours: dull sandy-brown scales on the back with darker brown bands, a pale cream throat and belly with one broad dark brown band across the throat below the hood, dark eyes, white fangs, a dark pink mouth, a black tongue.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it faces left, the front of its body reared up and drawn back in an S ready to strike, its hood spread and turned a little toward the viewer so the pale throat with its dark band shows, mouth open, the rest of its body in one loose loop behind and below it.
must_show: a real snake reared up with a spread cobra hood
plain sandy-brown and cream colouring, a dark throat band
open mouth with fangs
a plain ordinary animal: slender, no crown, no gold

what: a sea snake: a real yellow-bellied sea snake, an animal, swimming. It is one long, thick, heavy, smooth snake, as thick as a man's arm, with a narrow pointed head, small dark eyes and a mouth open at the tip to show two small fangs. Its body is flattened from side to side like a ribbon standing on its edge. The last part of its tail does not taper to a point: it stays flat and deep and ends in a blunt rounded oar-blade, only twice as deep as the body, a smooth continuation of the tail with no neck or stalk before it. The upper half of its body is glossy black from nose to tail and the lower half is bright yellow, with a sharp straight line between the two; the flat tail blade is coloured like the rest of the snake, black above and yellow below, crossed by three broad black bars.
colours: glossy black upper half, bright lemon-yellow lower half, a flat paddle tail black above and yellow below with three broad black bars, small dark eyes, white fangs.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it swims to the left through empty water in three deep S-shaped waves, each wave half the height of the picture, so that its thick body fills the picture from left to right and from top to bottom, its head at the left raised a little with the mouth open to bite, its flat barred paddle tail at the right.
must_show: a real snake seen from the side, swimming in S-waves
black back and bright yellow belly with a sharp line between
a broad flat paddle tail with black spots, readable in the small sprite
a plain animal, no hood
must_not_show: tail shaped like a cup, fan or wedge of cheese
tail wider than the head is long

what: a rock python: a real African rock python, an animal, the heaviest of these snakes: one very thick, heavy, muscular snake, as thick as a man's thigh, heaped in three fat overlapping coils, with its neck and head lifted out of the top of the heap. It has a long flat wedge-shaped head with a dark arrowhead mark on top, small eyes, and jaws stretched wide open showing rows of small backward-curving white teeth and a pale mouth. It has no hood. Its skin is patterned from end to end with big irregular dark blotches joined in a broken chain down the back.
colours: light tan and sandy-yellow skin with big dark chocolate-brown blotches edged in black, a pale cream belly, a dark brown arrowhead mark on the head, a pale pinkish-white mouth, white teeth.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, its thick body lies heaped in three heavy coils, and from the top of the heap its head and neck lunge out to the left in a strike, jaws gaping wide, the thick blunt tail end showing at the right of the heap.
must_show: one very thick heavy snake in fat coils, far thicker than the cobra
tan skin with big dark brown blotches
wedge head lunging with jaws wide open
no hood

what: a lindworm of Scandinavian folk tale: a wingless dragon in the shape of one enormous serpent. Its body is a single long, thick, scaled snake body, heaped in two big coils at the bottom and rearing up out of them in a tall S-curved neck. Its head is a dragon's head, not a snake's: a long bony snout with flared nostrils, a heavy jaw full of long white fangs, two pale horns sweeping back from the brow, and pale cold eyes. A thick shaggy black mane runs from between its horns down the back of its neck, as on a horse. Its scales are big, heavy and plated. Tatters of old shed skin, thin and pale as paper, hang from its neck.
colours: dark pine-green scales on the back with black edges, a pale bone-yellow plated belly, a shaggy black mane, pale ivory horns, pale yellow eyes, white fangs, a dark mouth, pale paper-white tatters of shed skin.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it rears up tall out of its two heavy coils, its maned neck drawn back in an S, its dragon head thrust forward to the left with jaws gaping to bite, and the thick end of its tail sweeping up and round at the right like a whip.
must_show: one huge serpent body in coils with a tall reared neck
a dragon's head with horns and fangs, not a snake's head
a black mane down the back of the neck, readable in the small sprite
dark green scales, pale belly
no wings and no hood: a wingless dragon-serpent, heavier and fiercer than the python

what: one of the brood of Nidhogg, the corpse-gnawing dragon that chews the roots of the World Tree in Norse myth: a lean, long-bodied, wingless wyrm that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, a real beast seen from the side, with its body horizontal. It has a long narrow dragon's head with a crown of short backswept pale horns and a heavy jaw of long teeth, a long neck, a long low body with every rib showing under the scales, four short strong legs with long pale claws, a ridge of tall pale bone spines, each as long as its head, standing all the way down its neck and back, and a very long thin tail. Its scales are black with a dull grey sheen on every ridge, its whole belly and throat are broad pale ash-grey plates, and on its flank, shoulder and thigh are three very large patches of pale ash-grey rot, each as big as its head, where the scales have gone dull and flaky. Clamped crosswise in its jaws is one thick pale length of tree root, as thick as its own neck, which it is gnawing.
colours: black and dark charcoal scales with a dull grey sheen and three very large patches of pale ash-grey rot, a pale ash-grey plated belly and throat, pale bone-white horns, tall pale bone-white spines and claws, dull yellow eyes, pale teeth, one pale cream-white tree root in its jaws.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing in its feet; exactly one thick pale tree root is clamped in its jaws.
pose: Seen from the side, it prowls to the left with all four of its feet planted on the ground and its body low and horizontal; its long neck is raised in an S-curve so that its head is the highest part of it, turned a little to the viewer and tilted as it gnaws the pale root clamped crosswise in its jaws; its long tail curls up high behind it and over its back in one big loop, so that the beast is nearly as tall as it is long and fills the picture.
must_show: a lean black wingless dragon on four legs, seen from the side, body horizontal
black scales with pale grey patches of rot
pale horns, spines and claws
a thick pale tree root clamped in its jaws, readable in the small sprite
no wings
must_not_show: small figure in an empty picture
tail lying flat on the ground

what: Echidna of Greek myth, the mother of monsters, half fair-cheeked nymph and half speckled serpent, as Hesiod describes her: a woman down to the hips, and from the hips down one great snake. Her upper half is a tall, strong, savage woman with a fair but furious face: brows drawn down in rage, wild amber eyes, lips pulled back in a snarl from clenched white teeth with two long white fangs, and a great mass of long tangled dark auburn hair. She has two arms, and her hands end in long hooked dark claws. She has no hips, no lap and no knees: at her belt her own body simply continues downward as one single enormous serpent's body, as wide as her waist, covered in pale grey-green scales, the colour of dry sage leaves, with big black spots, each spot as big as her hand. This snake body stands straight up under her like a thick pillar for the length of her own torso, then bends and winds into two heavy coils and ends in a tail tip raised behind her. She has a small head, a long neck and long strong arms.
colours: fair living skin on the face and arms, long tangled dark auburn hair, amber eyes, white fangs, a dark pine-green Greek dress with a bronze border, a bronze diadem, a broad bronze collar and bronze arm rings, a serpent body of pale grey-green scales, the colour of dry sage leaves, covered with big black spots, a pale cream belly, dark claws.
wears: She wears a short dark pine-green ancient Greek tunic pinned with a bronze brooch at each shoulder, which covers her upper body from the collarbone down and stops at a broad bronze belt at her waist. Nothing hangs below the belt: there the spotted serpent scales begin at once. She wears a bronze diadem on her brow, a broad bronze collar and heavy bronze arm rings on both upper arms.
holds: Her hands are empty and she holds nothing; both clawed hands are raised and spread to rake.
pose: She rears up tall and lunges to the left, her woman's body held high on the upright pillar of her own serpent body, her right clawed hand raised high above her head to slash down and her left clawed hand reaching out low ahead, snarling with her fangs bared, hair flying, the two heavy spotted coils heaped below and the tail tip lashing up behind at the right.
must_show: a woman above the waist, clothed in a dark green Greek dress, with long wild dark hair and a furious snarling face
one thick serpent body growing straight down from her waist, sandy-yellow with big black spots, upright under her and then coiled: she is joined to it, not sitting on it
bronze diadem, collar and arm rings: a mini-boss, the mother of monsters
empty clawed hands raised to strike, fangs bared
wilder and fiercer than a queen: no crown, no robe

what: a yuan-ti pureblood: one of the serpent folk who passes for a human at a glance, a lean, wiry desert caravan guide, a man standing on two legs. His head is shaved bare and hairless with no eyebrows. His face is a narrow human face with weather-beaten light tan skin, a thin mouth and two unblinking yellow eyes with black slit pupils. What gives him away: glossy dark emerald snake scales cover his whole throat and neck, both sides of his jaw up to the cheekbones, and all of the top and back of his bare skull like a tight cap, leaving only the middle of his face as tan skin; both his hands and bare forearms are scaled the same dark emerald; and a long thin forked black tongue flicks out of his mouth. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: weather-beaten light tan skin on the face, glossy dark emerald-green scales on the neck, jaw, skull, hands and forearms, yellow slit eyes, a long dusty travelling coat of undyed pale sand-beige linen, the colour of dry sand, a dark red sash, dark brown boots and belt, a scimitar with a bright steel blade and a brass hilt.
wears: He wears a caravan guide's plain travelling clothes, dusty and travel-worn: a long coat of undyed pale sand-beige linen to his knees with the collar open at the scaled throat and the sleeves rolled to the elbows, a wide dark red sash round his waist, loose trousers of the same pale linen tucked into dark brown boots, and a coil of rope at his belt. His head is bare. He wears no armour.
holds: He holds exactly one scimitar in his right hand: a broad curved single-edged steel blade, widest near the tip, with a brass hilt. His left hand is empty, held open and low at his side with the scaled back of the hand showing.
pose: He steps to the left on two legs in a low fencer's stance, knees bent, front foot forward, his right arm raised with the scimitar swept up and back over his shoulder to cut, his empty left hand held out low for balance, head turned to the viewer with the forked tongue flicking out.
must_show: a lean bare-headed human-looking man in a pale sand-beige travelling coat
dark green scales on the neck, jaw, skull and forearms, readable in the small sprite
yellow slit eyes and a forked tongue
one curved scimitar in the right hand, left hand empty
the plainest of the scale folk: no armour, no hood

what: a troglodyte: a squat, hunched, thick-bodied lizard-man of the deep caves that has never seen the sun, standing on two bowed legs. Every part of it is covered in dull, slimy, pebbly scales the colour of wet ash. It has a broad flat lizard's head with a blunt snout, a wide mouth of small sharp teeth, two big bulging milk-pale eyes, no ears, and a tall ragged crest of stiff spines standing up along the top of its skull and down its neck and back. It has a pot belly, short thick arms ending in three-fingered hands with long dirty claws, short bowed legs with clawed feet, and a short thick tail. An oily sheen glistens on its hide. It is shorter and squatter than a man.
colours: dull wet ash-grey scales on every part of the body with a paler dirty cream belly, a dark charcoal crest of spines, bulging milk-pale eyes, yellowed teeth and claws, a ragged dark brown hide loincloth.
wears: It wears only a ragged dark brown hide loincloth on a cord, with one cracked bone toggle. It has no armour and nothing on its head.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing; both clawed hands are open.
pose: It lurches to the left on two bowed legs, hunched low with knees bent, both clawed hands raised and spread in front of it to rake, its wide mouth gaping to bite, crest raised, the short tail stuck out behind for balance.
must_show: a squat hunched lizard-man on two legs with a short tail
dull grey scales all over, pale bulging eyes
a crest of spines along the skull and back
empty clawed hands, no weapon
a savage: only a hide loincloth

what: a viper priestess: a grim priestess of an ancient snake cult, keeper of a snake goddess older than the cities. She is a tall, gaunt, stern, hard-faced woman of middle age standing on two legs, with sallow pale tan skin, hollow cheeks, a long thin nose, a hard closed mouth, heavy black-lined eyes that do not blink and gold irises with slit pupils. She is wrapped from her chin to the ground in heavy dark robes. She grips one live viper in her raised fist, a thick snake as thick as her wrist. She has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: sallow pale tan skin, gold slit eyes ringed with black, a long heavy robe of very dark blue-black wool, a head-cloth of the same blue-black, one narrow sash of dull dark red with an ochre zigzag, a dull bronze brow-band and dull bronze bracelets, a thick pale grey-tan viper with a bold black zigzag down its back, a staff of black wood with a dull bronze snake's head.
wears: She wears one long, heavy, plain robe of very dark blue-black wool that covers her completely from a high closed collar under her chin to the ground, with long loose sleeves to her wrists; the robe hangs straight and heavy in deep folds and hides her feet. A cloth of the same blue-black is wound closely round her head and neck and covers all her hair, and over it across her brow sits a dull bronze band whose front rears up as one small cobra head. Round her waist is one narrow sash of dull dark red with an ochre zigzag, its two ends hanging to her knees. She has dull bronze bracelets on her wrists. Only her face and hands are bare.
holds: In her left fist, raised high above her head with the arm straight, she grips exactly one live pale grey-tan viper by its middle: the thick snake hangs out of both sides of her fist, its head rearing up above her hand with jaws open and its tail curling down past her elbow. The snake touches nothing but her hand and arm. In her right hand, held low at her side and slanting forward, she holds exactly one short fang-staff: a thick straight rod of black wood no longer than her arm, ending in a big dull bronze viper's head with open jaws and two long bronze fangs.
pose: She steps forward to the left on two legs under her long dark robe, her left arm raised straight up above her head gripping the live viper in her fist, her right hand low at her hip thrusting the short fang-staff forward with its bronze fanged head toward her enemy, chin lowered, her unblinking gold eyes fixed on the viewer. Her two hands are far apart: one high, one low.
must_show: a gaunt stern woman wrapped from chin to ground in a plain dark blue-black robe with long sleeves
a dark head-cloth covering her hair, with a bronze cobra brow-band
one live pale viper gripped in the raised left fist, high above her head
one short staff with a fanged bronze snake's head in the lowered right hand
grim and dark: a cult priestess, not a costume doll
must_not_show: staff as tall as she is

what: a plague witch of the years of the Black Death: a gaunt, stooped, haggard old woman of sixty standing on two legs, a well-poisoner who carries the sickness herself. Her skin is the colour of old candle wax, grey-yellow and unhealthy, on her face and hands alike. She has a long bony face with a sharp jutting chin, deep lines, sunken cheeks, dark bruised hollows round small fever-bright eyes, thin cracked lips drawn back from a few grey teeth, and big dark plague blotches on her cheek, her neck and the backs of her long bony hands. Lank strands of grey hair hang out from under her hood. She has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long thin limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: waxy grey-yellow skin with dark blotches, grey hair, a deep forest-green hood and shoulder cape, a long patched mud-brown dress with a dirty grey-cream apron, a dark leather belt, a dull brass handbell, a wisp of dirty yellow-grey smoke.
wears: She wears a deep forest-green medieval hood with a short shoulder cape, the hood drawn up over her hair but leaving her whole face plainly seen; a long patched mud-brown wool dress with long sleeves, a stained cream apron, a dark leather belt hung with small cloth pouches and a bundle of dried herbs, and worn leather shoes.
holds: She holds exactly one brass handbell in her right hand, a big plain bell with a short wooden handle, raised and ringing. Her left hand is held out ahead, palm up with the bony fingers curled like a claw, and from the palm rises one small twisting wisp of dirty yellow-grey smoke no taller than her head, joined to the hand. There is no ball, no orb and no fruit in her hand. She has no staff.
pose: She shuffles forward to the left on two legs, bent and stooped, her right arm raised high swinging the brass handbell above her shoulder, her left arm thrust out ahead with the wisp of foul smoke rising from its clawed palm, her head pushed forward on a scrawny neck, mouth open croaking.
must_show: a gaunt haggard old woman with waxy grey-yellow skin in a green hood and shoulder cape, face plainly seen
patched brown dress and apron, fully clothed
one brass handbell raised in the right hand
a small wisp of dirty yellow smoke rising from the left palm
a living woman, grim and sick, not a skeleton
must_not_show: cloud of mist around the body

what: a deep-one priest: a priest of the sea-folk who were once coast villagers, a stooped, broad-backed creature of the deep sea standing on two legs, with the body of a man and the head of a fish. His head is a big fish's head set straight on his shoulders with no neck: broad, blunt and scaly, with a huge wide gaping mouth right across it, thick pale lips turned down at the corners, no nose, no chin, no ears and no hair, and two enormous round flat yellow eyes with black pupils, one on each side of the head, each as big as his fist, that never blink. Three dark gill slits open on each side of his thick throat, and a low spiny fin runs over the top of his head. His skin is wet and scaly, dark sea-green on his head, arms and hands, with a pale yellowish-white throat. His big hands and his bare feet are webbed between long fingers and toes.
colours: wet dark sea-green scaly skin with a pale yellowish-white throat, enormous yellow eyes with black pupils, a long sea-rotted robe of dark teal with a pale gold border, a tall pale gold tiara, a staff of black driftwood with a pale bone harpoon head.
wears: He wears the sea-rotted vestments of a priest: a long heavy dark teal robe to his ankles, its hem ragged and hung with a few pale barnacles, a broad stole edged in pale gold hanging round his shoulders, a rope belt, and on his head a tall strange tiara of pale gold, oval at the front, worked with wave patterns. His webbed feet are bare.
holds: He holds exactly one barbed staff upright in his right hand: a thick straight staff of black driftwood as tall as he is, topped with one big pale bone harpoon head with three backward-pointing barbs down each side. His left hand is empty, raised high with the webbed fingers spread wide in invocation.
pose: He shuffles forward to the left on two bowed legs with one webbed foot ahead, stooped, his left arm raised high with the webbed hand spread open calling up the tide, his right hand planting the barbed staff forward at an angle, his wide mouth open croaking a prayer, his round eyes staring at the viewer.
must_show: a fish's head on a man's body: enormous round yellow eyes, a huge wide gaping mouth, no nose, no hair
dark sea-green scaly skin, webbed hands
a long dark teal priest's robe and a tall pale gold tiara
one staff topped with a barbed bone harpoon head in the right hand
empty webbed left hand raised
must_not_show: pale grey or pale blue human skin

what: a pit fiend spawn: a devil newly raised to the highest rank of the Nine Hells, a cold commander who kills without anger. It is a very tall, lean, wiry, long-limbed, narrow-waisted fiend standing bolt upright on two legs like a judge, hard and sinewy, never bulky, and fully fleshed and scaled, with no bones showing anywhere. Its whole body, head, neck, arms and legs alike, is covered in big hard overlapping scales the dark red-black of cooling iron, almost black in the hollows, with dull dark red showing only on the ridges of the scales. The front of its chest and belly is covered by broad flat overlapping plates of dull black horn, banded one above the other like the belly plates of a great snake. Its head is long and narrow and scaled, with a long reptile jaw and a row of six short straight black horns standing up along its brow like the points of an iron crown. Its two small eyes burn bright venom-green, and bright venom-green slaver runs in thick strings from its long white fangs. Its two enormous wings are like the sails of an old ship: the wing bones are dark red-black, but the skin stretched between them is dull pale grey-tan like weathered sailcloth, stained, patched with darker squares and torn at the lower edge. The wings are folded half shut and hang from the tops of its shoulders down to its heels, one on each side of its body, with one hooked black claw standing up above each shoulder. It has long thin arms with long black claws, clawed feet and one long thin scaled tail. It has a small head for its body.
colours: scales the dark red-black of cooling iron with dull dark red ridges, broad dull black horn plates down the chest and belly, black horns and claws, bright venom-green eyes and venom-green slaver, white fangs, wings with dark red-black bones and dull pale grey-tan skin like weathered sailcloth with darker patches, one plain black iron collar.
wears: It wears nothing but one plain heavy black iron collar round its neck, the mark of its new rank.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: its right arm is stretched straight out ahead of it, one long black-clawed finger pointing in command; its left hand hangs open at its side, claws spread.
pose: On two legs, it walks to the left with a slow measured stride, bolt upright, one clawed foot forward, its right arm stretched straight out ahead pointing one long clawed finger at its enemy like a commander giving an order, its left hand hanging open, its two great pale sail-like wings folded half shut and hanging from shoulders to heels behind it, its long head lowered a little, jaws open with green venom running from the fangs, the thin tail curling behind its heels.
must_show: a tall, lean, upright fiend in dark red-black scales with black banded belly plates, fully fleshed
two great wings like old patched ship's sails: pale grey-tan skin on dark bones, hanging half folded
a long narrow head with a row of short black horns like an iron crown
venom-green eyes and green venom running from the fangs
one arm stretched out pointing in command; empty hands, an iron collar
not the common bright red horned bat-winged devil, and not a skeleton
must_not_show: wings the same red as the body
standing square-on with both arms hanging

what: a wormwood blight: the thing that grew where the burning star Wormwood of the Book of Revelation fell and turned the waters bitter. It is one upright, bushy, spreading growth, as tall as it is wide, part fungus and part dead thornbush, as pale as ash, painted in thick detail. At its heart, held fast in the growth, sits one fallen star-stone: a jagged black cinder as big as a boulder, split by cracks that glow dull bitter yellow. Round the stone stand about eight thick, twisted, pale stalks, each as thick as a leg, rising upright side by side with wide dark gaps between them, bare, knotted and thorny, and swollen among the stalks are a few big round pale bladders, each as big as the star-stone, some split open at the top and spilling a short curl of bile-yellow spore dust that is joined to the bladder. Three thick pale stalks bend out to the left at different heights, each ending in a blunt frayed tip. It has no face.
colours: pale ash-white and bone-grey stalks with dark charcoal gaps and shadows between them, pale grey-white bladders with dull yellow stains, one black cinder stone with dull bitter-yellow glowing cracks, short curls of bile-yellow spore dust.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The growth stands upright in the middle of the picture, wholly inside the picture with empty backdrop on every side, the black star-stone with its yellow cracks in its centre, the thick pale stalks rising round it, three of them bending out to the left to strike, two of the big bladders at the top bursting open with short curls of bile-yellow dust. It is one compact mass with a clean lower edge.
must_show: a pale ash-white growth of thick twisted stalks and big round bladders, painted and weathered
one black star-stone with yellow glowing cracks lodged in its middle, readable in the small sprite
pale root-arms lashing out to one side
bile-yellow spore dust at the bladders, small and attached
no face, no eyes

what: a pit executioner: one of Abaddon's headsmen, a damned judge made into a demon, a towering, enormously broad, thick-armed, heavy-bellied executioner standing on two legs. His skin is dark slate-grey like cold iron on his arms, chest and hands alike. His whole head is shut inside an executioner's hood made of black iron: a smooth pointed iron hood shaped to the head, fixed to his skull by a ring of big round rivets round the brow and neck, with no face on it, only two small round eye-holes that glow dull ember-yellow. He has a small head for his body, very wide sloping shoulders and arms as thick as his legs.
colours: dark slate-grey skin, a black iron riveted hood with two dull ember-yellow eye-holes, a long black leather butcher's apron, the torn remains of a judge's black robe with a ragged dirty white collar band, black iron wrist bands and a heavy black chain belt, a cleaver with a pale grey steel blade, a maul with a dark iron head.
wears: He wears the riveted black iron hood, a long heavy black leather butcher's apron from chest to shins, and over his shoulders the torn remains of a judge's black robe with a ragged dirty white collar band at the throat; black iron bands on both wrists and a heavy chain round his waist as a belt. His thick arms are bare.
holds: In his right hand, raised above his head, he holds exactly one great butcher's cleaver by its short stubby handle: the handle is no longer than his hand, and straight out of his fist comes a huge flat rectangular blade of pale grey steel, as broad as his chest, with a square end. The cleaver has no pole. In his left hand, held out low in front of his belly where it is plainly seen, he grips exactly one iron maul by a haft no longer than his forearm: a big plain square block of dark iron, as big as his own head.
pose: He stamps forward to the left on two legs with one heavy boot ahead, his body twisted, his right arm raised high with the great cleaver lifted above his hooded head to chop down, his left arm bent and held out low before him with the iron maul gripped in his fist, its square iron head forward, his hooded head lowered and staring ahead.
must_show: a huge heavy executioner with dark slate-grey skin
a black iron hood riveted over the whole head, two glowing eye-holes, no face
black leather apron and the torn black robe with a white collar band
one huge rectangular cleaver raised in the right hand
one short iron maul in the left hand

what: a moss sentinel: an ancient boundary stone that the moss has woken, a weathered granite statue of a helmeted border-warden in a long stone cloak, hunched and neckless, its small helmeted head sunk between its shoulders, its arms thicker than its legs. The stone is rough grey granite, worn, pitted and cracked, with the carving half rubbed away: a stern face with a heavy brow, two small eyes glowing dull amber set in the rock, and a carved spiral on its chest. Thick shaggy deep-green moss has grown all over its shoulders, back and upper arms like a heavy fur mantle and hangs in long beards from its elbows and jaw, with small ferns sprouting from its shoulders. Its two fists are great bare knobs of grey stone. From its right wrist grows one long thick dark thorn-vine, as thick as a rope, set with big hooked thorns.
colours: weathered mid-grey and dark grey granite with pale grey chipped edges, thick deep-green moss with yellow-green highlights, dull amber eyes, one dark brown thorn-vine with pale thorns.
wears: It wears nothing but its own carved stone cloak and helmet and the moss that covers it. It has no cloth and no metal.
holds: Its hands hold nothing: its left hand is an empty stone fist, raised; from its right wrist grows exactly one thick thorn-vine that it lashes like a whip.
pose: It lumbers forward to the left on two short thick stone legs with one foot ahead, its body twisted, its left stone fist raised high above its shoulder to pound down, its right arm swung out ahead with the thick thorn-vine lashing forward from the wrist in one bold curve, its mossy head lowered.
must_show: a hunched worn grey stone statue of a helmeted warden, plainly rock
thick green moss covering the shoulders, back and arms like a mantle
bare grey stone fists, one raised
one thick thorn-vine lashing from the right wrist
weathered, ancient and serious
must_not_show: all-green body with no stone showing

what: a throne sentinel: an empty suit of the finest royal plate armour, cast for a king's bodyguard and set moving by court enchanters, standing tall and straight-backed on two legs like a knight of the royal guard. There is no man inside: the helm is closed, and behind the narrow eye-slit of the visor there is only darkness and a steady pale ice-white glow. The armour is superb smithwork: fluted, polished silver-steel plate with fine gold inlay along every edge, a tall closed helm with a pointed visor and a tall stiff plume, great fluted shoulder pieces, a fluted breastplate and full arm and leg harness. It has the proportions of a tall man: a small helm, broad shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: polished silver-steel plate with fine gold inlay and gold edges, a tall dark royal-blue plume, a dark royal-blue tabard skirt and short cape with a gold border, a pale ice-white glow in the eye-slit, a halberd with a dark wooden shaft and a bright steel head, a shield of dark royal-blue with a gold rim.
wears: It is a complete suit of fluted silver-steel plate with gold inlay from helm to sabatons, with a tall dark royal-blue plume on the helm, a dark royal-blue tabard skirt with a gold border hanging from the waist, and a short dark royal-blue cape from the shoulders.
holds: It holds exactly one halberd in its right gauntlet: a thick straight dark wooden pole taller than itself, with a broad bright steel axe blade on one side near the top, a hooked spike on the other side, and a long steel spear point at the very tip. On its left arm it carries exactly one tall kite-shaped shield of plain dark royal-blue with a broad gold rim.
pose: It strides to the left on two legs with one armoured foot forward, its body turned, the tall shield held out before its chest on its left arm, its right arm drawn back and raised with the halberd swung high, the axe blade above and behind its plumed helm ready to cleave downward, cape swept back.
must_show: a tall suit of fine fluted silver plate armour with gold inlay, closed helm, no face
a pale glow in the eye-slit
tall dark blue plume and dark blue tabard
one halberd: a long pole with an axe blade and a spear point
one kite shield on the left arm
a royal guard: far finer and cleaner than the moss-covered stone sentinel
must_not_show: plain spear with no axe blade

what: a roc chick: the half-grown nestling of the giant bird of the Sinbad stories, drawn as a real eagle nestling a few weeks old, a gawky, fierce, ugly young bird of prey standing on two legs. Its whole body is covered in thick shaggy ash-grey down, with the first dark brown feathers pushing through in rows on its short stubby wings, which are far too small to fly. It has a head that looks too big, with a huge heavy smooth hooked beak like an eagle's, a wide gaping mouth with a pointed tongue, a bare patch of grey skin round each fierce dark eye and a scruffy crest of down; a scrawny neck; a round belly; and two thick scaly yellow legs with enormous yellow feet and long black curved talons, far too big for it. Hanging from the hooked tip of its beak is one small knight's horse saddle, no bigger than the bird's own head, gripped by its girth strap: a curved brown leather seat that rises to a high peak at the front and a high curved back, with a flat leather flap on each side, and below each flap one iron stirrup, a D-shaped iron loop, dangling on a long strap. The chick has eaten the horse.
colours: shaggy ash-grey and dirty white down, dark brown new feathers on the wings, a horn-yellow beak with a dark grey hooked tip, dull yellow scaly legs and feet, black talons, dark eyes, one small dark brown leather saddle with two grey iron stirrups.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: Exactly one small brown leather horse saddle with two dangling iron stirrups hangs by its girth strap from the tip of its beak. Its feet hold nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it lurches to the left on its two big yellow feet, one foot lifted high with the talons spread to grab, its two short stubby wings raised and flapping for balance, neck stretched forward and up, shaking the small saddle that hangs from its huge hooked beak.
must_show: a real eagle nestling: shaggy grey down, short stubby wings with a few dark feathers
a huge hooked beak, enormous yellow feet and black talons
a small leather saddle hanging from the beak, showing the bird's size
gawky and fierce, a real young bird of prey, not a cute chick

what: a satyr trickster of Greek myth, a follower of Dionysus: a lean, wiry, sly man above the waist and a goat below, standing on two goat legs. He has a sharp weather-beaten light tan face with a crooked knowing grin, a short pointed dark brown beard, a snub nose, long pointed ears that stick out sideways, a mop of curly dark brown hair, and two short thick ridged goat horns curving back from his forehead. From the waist down he has the hind legs of a goat: shaggy dark brown hair, backward-bending hocks and two black cloven hooves, with a short upturned goat tail. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about seven heads tall.
colours: weather-beaten light tan skin, curly dark brown hair and beard, grey-brown ridged horns, shaggy dark brown goat legs with black hooves, a short dull dark olive-green tunic, a wreath of dark ivy leaves, pale straw-yellow reed panpipes, a small dark red leather purse.
wears: He wears a short ragged sleeveless tunic of dull dark olive-green wool that covers his chest and belly and hangs to the tops of his goat thighs, tied with a cord, and a wreath of dark ivy leaves in his hair. He wears no armour.
holds: He holds exactly one set of panpipes in his right hand, held a hand's width below his chin and clear of his face, so that his whole grinning bearded face shows above them: a row of seven thick pale reed pipes of stepped lengths bound side by side, as wide as his face. In his left hand, held out behind him, he dangles exactly one small dark red leather coin purse by its drawstring: a stolen purse.
pose: He skips away to the left on his two goat legs, one hoof lifted high in a dancing step, his body twisted to look back over his shoulder at the viewer with a sly grin, his right hand holding the panpipes just below his chin, his whole face showing above them, his left arm stretched out behind him dangling the stolen purse.
must_show: a man above the waist with goat legs and black cloven hooves
short goat horns, pointed ears, pointed beard
a short ochre tunic covering the chest
one set of panpipes in the right hand, readable in the small sprite
one small purse dangling from the left hand
a thief and piper: no weapon, no armour

what: a maddened pegasus: the winged horse of Greek myth, driven mad by long confinement underground. It is a real horse, a tall strong white stallion on four legs, with two great feathered swan-white wings growing from its shoulders. It is wild and half-starved: its ribs show a little, its long white mane and tail are tangled and dirty, its ears are laid flat back, its eyes roll white with dark rims, its nostrils are flared and its mouth is open with the teeth bared and foam at the lips. It has no horn.
colours: a white coat with pale grey shadows and dirty grey streaks on the legs and flanks, white wing feathers with pale grey tips, a tangled grey-white mane and tail, dark-rimmed rolling eyes, dark grey hooves, short bright yellow sparks at the front hooves.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing: no bridle, no saddle.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it charges to the left at a full gallop on four legs, its body horizontal, its two front legs reaching far ahead and its two hind legs driving off behind, neck stretched out low, ears flat, teeth bared, both wings raised high above its back and swept back, mane and tail streaming, a few short bright yellow zigzag sparks crackling on its two front hooves and touching them.
must_show: a real white horse on four legs, seen from the side, galloping
two big white feathered wings raised above its back
mad and wild: ears flat, teeth bared, tangled mane
white coat, no horn
